claim: 你身上有一股改變現狀的力量；這股力量用得好不好，在於變的時候有沒有目標。
en: You carry a strong drive to change things; whether it works for you depends on whether your changes have a goal.
limit: 原文以頑嚚與果敢分兩頭；英星入廟、破軍暗曜等格局另論。

claim: 你的盤偏果敢：你不主動求變，但形勢非變不可時，你行動俐落，而且變得有目標。
en: Your chart leans decisive: you do not seek change for its own sake, but when it becomes unavoidable you act cleanly and with a purpose.

claim: 你的盤偏莽撞：破壞的力氣大過創造的力氣，往往主動去拆，拆的時候又沒有目的。
en: Your chart leans reckless: your power to tear down outweighs your power to build, and you tend to break things up on your own initiative, without a clear aim.

claim: 你有突然興創事業的能力，為人果敢，也有條件成為帶領企業的人。
en: You have the ability to start ventures suddenly and act decisively, and you have what it takes to lead an enterprise.
limit: 原文稱「英星入廟」，最喜對宮見祿；稍帶煞即無全美，不可寫成必然成功。

claim: 你有一股執拗：容易被自己的想法蒙住，認定了就一意孤行。
en: You have a stubborn streak: you are easily blinded by your own ideas and press on once you have made up your mind.
limit: 原文「破軍暗曜」：文曲化忌同度或對宮拱照。

claim: 你做事常常新舊並行：一邊守住舊的，一邊開出新的，往往身兼幾樣工作。
en: You tend to run old and new side by side, keeping one thing going while starting another, and often hold several jobs at once.

claim: 你的新事業多半由舊事業帶出來，而且新舊可以同時經營。
en: Your new ventures usually grow out of old ones, and you can run both at the same time.

claim: 你多半靠自己起家，但不必推倒一切，可以借長輩留下的基礎再自行改革。
en: You mostly build things yourself, but you need not tear everything down: you can use what your elders left and reform it your own way.

claim: 你和家人的緣分較淡，很多事要親力親為，不能指望別人代勞。
en: Your ties with family are thinner; many things you must do yourself rather than count on others.
limit: 原文指不成英星入廟格的子午破軍；原文另有「易染疾患」，不寫。

claim: 你寧為玉碎、不為瓦全：不肯將就，所以手上的東西也容易耗散。
en: You would rather break than bend: you refuse to settle, so what you hold also tends to drain away.

claim: {decades}這幾個十年是你一生運程的樞紐，順逆對整體影響很大。
en: {decades}: these decades are the pivots of your life; how they go weighs heavily on the whole.
limit: 原文：大運以武曲或紫府為樞紐；原局破軍無祿見煞，行至財星宮垣見祿見吉能補救，不見祿而見煞則一生運程大打折扣。原文另列巨門、天梁宮垣為樞紐（未分大限流年），未寫入。

claim: {decades}這段時間，是你開始發跡的十年。
en: The years {decades} are when you begin to rise.
limit: 原文另說不宜再行破軍流年、武曲或廉貞化忌宮限。

claim: {decades}這段時間，在幾個變動較大的十年之中，對你最為有利。
en: {decades}: among your decades of upheaval, this one suits you best.

claim: 這十年多改變的機會，即使沒有額外的助力，你也能借機改善處境。
en: This decade brings many chances for change; even without extra help, you can use them to improve your situation.

claim: 這十年氣氛較祥和，能化解你主動去拆的衝動；再凡事三思而後行，也有機會避開困境。
en: This decade has a calmer air that softens your urge to tear things down; if you also think twice before acting, you have a chance of avoiding trouble.

claim: 這十年你容易錯失機會，也未必善用運勢，改變往往只停在表面。
en: In this decade you tend to miss chances and may not use the momentum well; changes often stay on the surface.

claim: 這十年你往往只知除舊、不知布新，要靠後天努力補上新的。
en: In this decade you tend to clear away the old without setting up the new; it takes deliberate effort to build something in its place.
limit: 原文「七殺的宮度有煞」：計本命四煞同度、大限流羊陀入大限命宮。

claim: 這十年環境特別好，連漫無目的的改變也能轉成有目的的建設。
en: Conditions are unusually good this decade: even aimless change can be turned into purposeful building.
limit: 原文說這純屬客觀環境太好，並非本質改變。

claim: 這十年是好運。
en: This decade is a good run for you.

claim: 這一年容易遇到機會。
en: This year opportunities come your way more easily.

claim: 這十年對你反而是好運；能不能把握，決定你往後的發展。
en: This decade actually favours you; whether you seize it decides how things go afterwards.

claim: 這十年要慎選目標：方向選錯，可能因此損失；求學的十年尤其要選好發展方向。
en: Choose your goals carefully in this decade: the wrong direction may cost you, and if these are your study years, pick your path with special care.

claim: 這十年往往是你容易破敗的運：缺乏目標，又容易因一時得意而失手。
en: This decade often brings setbacks for you: you lack a clear goal and can slip up through a moment of overconfidence.
limit: 原文另說紫府偏精神者更不宜，條件語言寫不出，未寫入。

claim: 這十年你往往能扭轉劣勢，在事業上有所建樹。
en: This decade you can often turn a poor position around and achieve something in your career.

claim: 這十年是你喜歡經行的好運，但不宜妄求大幅度的改變，也不宜漫無目標地變。
en: This is a decade you welcome, but do not force sweeping changes, and do not change things without a goal.

claim: 這十年容易受人慫恿而妄動，招來損失；不宜冒進。
en: This decade others may egg you on into rash moves that cost you; do not push ahead.

claim: 這十年你容易自己衝動妄動，招來損失；不宜冒進。
en: This decade your own impulses can lead you into rash moves that cost you; do not push ahead.

claim: 這十年是進取的運，適合主動爭取。
en: This is a decade for advancing; go after what you want.

claim: 這十年運勢容易生出破敗。
en: This decade is prone to setbacks.

claim: 這十年不宜作任何積極的舉動。
en: This decade is not the time for any bold moves.

claim: 這十年是你的好運。
en: This decade is a good run for you.
limit: 破軍子午，巨門必在巳亥、太陽在對宮；太陽在巳為入廟。

claim: 這十年你仍容易惹是生非。
en: Even so, in this decade you still tend to stir up trouble.

claim: 這一年容易有情緒上的挫折。
en: This year you are prone to emotional setbacks.
limit: 原文另有煞忌刑並湊的更重講法，不寫。

claim: 這一年適合改變外在環境。
en: This year suits changing your outward circumstances.

claim: 這十年只宜退居幕後策劃，不宜站到前面；即使順遂，也不改這個性質。
en: This decade calls for planning from behind the scenes rather than stepping forward; even if things go smoothly, that does not change.

claim: 這一年只宜退居幕後策劃，不宜站到前面。
en: This year calls for planning from behind the scenes rather than stepping forward.

claim: 這十年要更小心地利用機會去改變形勢。
en: This decade you must be more careful in how you use chances to change things.

claim: 這十年是你能藉此創立事業的好運。
en: This decade is a good time for you to found something of your own.

claim: 這十年改革不宜太快，否則容易惹起不必要的麻煩，真正機會來時已無餘力。
en: Do not reform too fast this decade, or you will stir up needless trouble and have nothing left when the real chance comes.

claim: 這十年是你立業的奠基期。
en: This decade lays the foundation of your career.

claim: 這十年你容易自己破壞運勢；趁運在，要確立發展目標，否則運過便白白辜負。
en: This decade you may undermine your own luck; while it lasts, fix a direction, or it will pass and be wasted.

claim: 這十年不是好運，不宜採取積極手段。
en: This is not a good decade; avoid aggressive moves.
limit: 原文「武曲化忌，沖起貪狼化忌」；這裡只寫得出武曲化忌。

claim: 這十年大致對你有利。
en: This decade generally works in your favour.

claim: 這十年你必多艱辛。
en: This decade is bound to be hard going for you.

claim: 這十年的艱辛容易激起你的破壞力，對往後的運勢影響很大。
en: The hardship of this decade can stir up your destructive side, with a large effect on the years that follow.

claim: 這十年對你不算有利。
en: This decade is not especially in your favour.
